description: For a team job from start_job only; an engagement from start_outcome moves with advance_outcome. Send the latest complete state and state_digest unchanged, with one event and its document. Each step checks its record; a refusal names the field to fix. Artifacts stay local; send hashes. This server keeps no copy, so there is no read or delete call: the state you hold is the record (read it from your local file; deleting that file ends the job). Every result is a host report, not proof of execution or consent.
name: advance_job
title: Check the next step of a team job
